name: append_spreadsheet_values
description: Appends values to a range in a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to append values to.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to append values to. Supports various formats:

Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Full row: "1:2"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names (recommended for multi-sheet spreadsheets):
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

Note: If no sheet name specified, first sheet is automatically used.
Values are appended after the last row of data in the specified range.

valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted. Allowed: 'RAW', 'USER_ENTERED'.

values.description: A 2D array of rows to append. Each inner array is one row; each cell is a string, number, boolean, or null (empty).

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

insertDataOption.description: How the input data should be inserted. Allowed: 'OVERWRITE', 'INSERT_ROWS'. Defaults to None (behaves like 'INSERT_ROWS' for appending).

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the appended values in the response. Defaults to False.

responseValueRenderOption.description: How values should be rendered in the response. Allowed: 'FORMATTED_VALUE', 'UNFORMATTED_VALUE', 'FORMULA'. Defaults to 'FORMATTED_VALUE'.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description: How dates, times, and durations should be rendered in the response. Allowed: 'SERIAL_NUMBER', 'FORMATTED_STRING'. Defaults to 'SERIAL_NUMBER'.

majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values. Allowed: 'ROWS' (default), 'COLUMNS'. Defaults to "ROWS".

name: batch_get_spreadsheet_values_by_data_filter

dataFilters.description: List of data filter objects. Each filter must specify exactly one of: a1Range, gridRange, or developerMetadataLookup (mutually exclusive). If None or empty, an empty "valueRanges" list is returned. Filters that do not match stored data are silently omitted from the response.

items.description: A single data filter. Must match exactly ONE of the mutually exclusive shapes below: an a1Range filter, a gridRange filter, or a developerMetadataLookup filter. Note: this simulation does not support 'developerMetadataLookup' and will raise at runtime if it is used.

anyOf.description: Data filter using A1 notation only.

gridRange.description: Grid range with non-negative, zero-based indices; row/column intervals are half-open [start, end).

sheetId.description: The sheet ID this range is on (non-negative).

startRowIndex.description: The start row index (inclusive). Omit for unbounded start.

endRowIndex.description: The end row index (exclusive). Omit for unbounded end.

startColumnIndex.description: The start column index (inclusive). Omit for unbounded start.

endColumnIndex.description: The end column index (exclusive). Omit for unbounded end.

anyOf.description: Data filter using developerMetadataLookup only (not supported by this simulation; calls fail at runtime).

developerMetadataLookup.description: Developer metadata lookup. Must include at least one property; at least one of metadataKey, metadataValue, or metadataId must be non-null (enforced by request validation).

metadataKey.description: The metadata key to look up.

metadataValue.description: The metadata value to look up.

metadataId.description: The metadata ID to look up (non-negative).

majorDimension.description: Major dimension for results ("ROWS" or "COLUMNS"). Defaults to "ROWS".

valueRenderOption.description: How values should be represented in the output. Valid values: "FORMATTED_VALUE", "UNFORMATTED_VALUE", "FORMULA". If not provided or None is passed, "FORMATTED_VALUE" is used.

dateTimeRenderOption.description: How dates, times, and durations should be represented in the output. This is ignored if valueRenderOption is "FORMATTED_VALUE". Valid values: "SERIAL_NUMBER", "FORMATTED_STRING". If not provided or None is passed, "SERIAL_NUMBER" is used.

userId.description: The user ID to use for accessing the spreadsheet. If not provided or None is passed, "me" is used.

name: batch_update_spreadsheet
description:
Applies one or more updates to the spreadsheet.

Description: This function applies one or more updates to the spreadsheet.
It supports the following request types:
- addSheetRequest - Adds a new sheet to the spreadsheet.
- deleteSheetRequest - Deletes an existing sheet from the spreadsheet.
- updateSheetPropertiesRequest - Updates the properties of an existing sheet.
- updateCells - Updates the cells in a specified range of the spreadsheet.
- updateSheetProperties - Updates the properties of an existing sheet.
The function validates the requests and updates the spreadsheet accordingly.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. If you do not have a spreadsheet ID, use create_spreadsheet to create a new spreadsheet first.

requests.description:
List of update requests. Defaults to None.
Each dictionary in the list must contain exactly one key, which specifies the type of
request. The value for that key is a dictionary payload for the request.
Supported request keys and their payload structures:
- 'addSheetRequest': Payload must conform to AddSheetRequestPayload.
     Requires 'properties'. sheetId is optional and auto-generated if omitted.
- 'deleteSheetRequest': Payload must conform to DeleteSheetRequestPayload.
    Requires 'sheetId'.
- 'updateSheetPropertiesRequest': Payload must conform to UpdateSheetPropertiesRequestPayload.
    Requires 'properties' (with 'sheetId') and 'fields'.
- 'updateCells': Payload must conform to UpdateCellsPayload.
    Requires 'range' and 'rows'.
- 'updateSheetProperties': Payload must conform to UpdateSheetPropertiesSimplePayload.
    Requires 'properties' (with 'sheetId'); 'fields' is optional.

.. hlist::
   :columns: 1

   * **addSheetRequest** (`Dict`) - Adds a new sheet.
   * **deleteSheetRequest** (`Dict`) - Deletes a sheet.
   * **updateSheetPropertiesRequest** (`Dict`) - Updates a sheet's properties.
   * **updateCells** (`Dict`) - Updates cells in a sheet.
   * **updateSheetProperties** (`Dict`) - Updates a sheet's properties (simplified).

.. rubric:: Requests

.. code-block:: json

   [
       {
           "addSheetRequest": {
               "properties": {
                   "sheetId": 1,
                   "title": "New Sheet"
               }
           }
       },
       {
           "deleteSheetRequest": {
               "sheetId": 0
           }
       }
   ]

.. container:: oneof

   .. container:: addSheetRequest

      Adds a new sheet.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: properties

      .. rubric:: Properties

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "sheetId": 12345,
             "title": "New Sheet"
         }

   .. container:: deleteSheetRequest

      Deletes a sheet.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: sheetId

      .. rubric:: sheetId

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "sheetId": 12345
         }

   .. container:: updateSheetPropertiesRequest

      Updates a sheet's properties.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: properties, fields

      .. rubric:: Properties and Fields

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "properties": {
                 "sheetId": 12345,
                 "title": "Updated Sheet"
             },
             "fields": "title"
         }

   .. container:: updateCells

      Updates cells in a sheet.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: rows, range

      .. rubric:: Rows and Range

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "rows": [
                 ["A1", "B1"],
                 ["A2", "B2"]
             ],
             "range": {
                 "sheetId": 0,
                 "startRowIndex": 0,
                 "endRowIndex": 2,
                 "startColumnIndex": 0,
                 "endColumnIndex": 2
             }
         }

name: batch_update_spreadsheet_values
description: Updates values in multiple ranges of a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Must be a non-empty string.

valueInputOption.description:
How the input data should be interpreted.
                  Valid values:
                  - "RAW": Values are inserted as-is, without any parsing.
                  - "USER_ENTERED": Values are parsed as if entered into Sheets by a user.
                    Formulas are stored as formulas, strings that look like dates or times
may be converted to date/time values, plain numbers are converted to numbers.

data.description: List of update requests, each containing a range and values to update.

items.description: An update request containing a range and values.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to update.
                                Supports various formats:
                                - Single cell: "A1"
                                - Cell range: "A1:B2"
                                - Full column: "A:B"
                                - Full row: "1:2"
                                - Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)
                                With sheet names:
                                - Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
                                - Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
                                - Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
                                - Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
                                - Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"
Note: If no sheet name is specified, uses first sheet in spreadsheet data.

values.description: A 2D array of rows to update. Each inner array is one row; each cell is a string, number, boolean, or null (empty).

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string (text), number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

includeValuesInResponse.description: Optional. Whether to include the updated values in the response. Defaults to False.

responseValueRenderOption.description:
Optional. How values should be rendered in the response. Defaults to "FORMATTED_VALUE".
Valid values:
- "FORMATTED_VALUE": Values are calculated and formatted as they appear in the UI.
- "UNFORMATTED_VALUE": Values are calculated but not formatted in the reply.
- "FORMULA": Values are not calculated. The reply includes formulas.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description:
Optional. How dates, times, and durations should be rendered in the response. Defaults to "SERIAL_NUMBER".
Valid values:
- "SERIAL_NUMBER": Date/time values are returned as Excel serial numbers.
- "FORMATTED_STRING": Date/time values are returned as formatted strings.

name: batch_update_spreadsheet_values_by_data_filter
description: Updates values in a spreadsheet using data filters.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

valueInputOption.description: Determines how input data should be interpreted. Valid values: "RAW" (values are stored as-is), "USER_ENTERED" (values are parsed as if entered by a user). "INPUT_VALUE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED" is not allowed and must not be used.

data.description:
List of update requests. Each request is a dictionary that must contain:
- values (required): A 2D array where each inner array represents a row of cell values. Each cell value can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).
- Either dataFilter OR range (but not both) to specify the target range:
    * dataFilter: An object containing 'a1Range' (string) - The A1 notation of the range (e.g., "Sheet1!A1:D3" or "A1:D3")
    * range: A string with the A1 notation of the range. Supports various formats:
      Basic ranges (uses default sheet): "A1", "A1:B2", "A:B", "A2:Z"
      With sheet names: "Sheet1!A1:B2", "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes for spaces), "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes), "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

items.description: Model for individual items in the 'data' list argument.

values.description: Required. The values to update in the range. A 2D array where each inner array represents a row of cell values.

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

dataFilter.description: Optional (use either this or "range", not both). A data filter object specifying the target range using structured criteria. Defaults to None.

a1Range.description: The A1 notation of the range. The A1 notation is a syntax used to define a cell or range of cells with a string that contains the sheet name plus the starting and ending cell coordinates using column letters and row numbers like: "Sheet1!A1:D3" or "A1:D3"

range.description:
Optional (use either this or "dataFilter", not both). The A1 notation of the range. Defaults to None. Supports various formats:
Basic ranges (uses default sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names:
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the updated values in the response. Defaults to False.

responseValueRenderOption.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. Valid values: "FORMATTED_VALUE", "UNFORMATTED_VALUE", "FORMULA". Defaults to "FORMATTED_VALUE".

name: clear_spreadsheet_values
description: Clears values from a specific range in a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to clear values from.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to clear values from. Supports various formats:

Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Full row: "1:2"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names (recommended for multi-sheet spreadsheets):
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"
- Sheet-only: "Sheet1" (entire sheet)

Note: If no sheet name is specified (e.g., "A1:B2"), the system automatically
uses the first sheet in the spreadsheet data. If a sheet name IS specified, it
must match an existing sheet title in the spreadsheet (use the title, not the
sheet ID); otherwise a ValueError is raised.

name: copy_sheet_to_spreadsheet
description: Copies a sheet to another spreadsheet.

sheet_id.description: The ID of the sheet to copy.

destination_spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to copy the sheet to.

spreadsheet.description: Dictionary representing the complete structure, properties, and data for a new spreadsheet.

id.description: IGNORED - The spreadsheet ID is auto-generated.

properties.description: Properties of a spreadsheet. Contains metadata and settings that define the overall behavior and appearance of the spreadsheet, including title, locale, time zone, recalculation settings, default cell formatting, iterative calculation configuration, and theme.

locale.description: The locale of the spreadsheet in one of the following formats: an ISO 639-1 language code such as en, an ISO 639-2 language code such as fil, if no 639-1 code exists, or a combination of the ISO language code and country code, such as en_US.

autoRecalc.description: The amount of time to wait before volatile functions are recalculated.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the spreadsheet, in CLDR format such as America/New_York. If the time zone isn't recognized, this may be a custom time zone such as GMT-07:00.

iterativeCalculationSettings.description: Determines whether and how circular references are resolved with iterative calculation. Absence of this field means that circular references result in calculation errors.

maxIterations.description: When iterative calculation is enabled, the maximum number of calculation rounds to perform.

convergenceThreshold.description: When iterative calculation is enabled and successive results differ by less than this threshold value, the calculation rounds stop.

primaryFontFamily.description: Name of the primary font family.

themeColors.description: The spreadsheet theme color pairs. To update you must provide all theme color pairs.

items.description: A pair mapping a spreadsheet theme color type to the concrete color it represents.

colorType.description: The type of the spreadsheet theme color.

color.description: The concrete color corresponding to the theme color type.

importFunctionsExternalUrlAccessAllowed.description: Whether to allow external URL access for image and import functions. Read only when true. When false, you can set to true. This value will be bypassed and always return true if the admin has enabled the allowlisting feature.

sheets.description: List of sheets in the spreadsheet. Each sheet has properties and optional data. Each sheetId and each explicit index must be unique when set; sheet titles must be unique in the workbook (comparison is case-insensitive, and missing titles are treated as 'Untitled Sheet').

items.description: A sheet within a spreadsheet. Contains the sheet properties, data, charts, conditional formatting rules, filter views, protected ranges, merged cells, and other sheet-level configurations.

properties.description: Sheet properties including ID, title, index, type, and grid dimensions.

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet. Must be non-negative. Auto-generated if not provided or None.

index.description: The index of the sheet within the spreadsheet. Auto-generated if not provided or None.

sheetType.description: The type of sheet. Defaults to GRID if not provided.

gridProperties.description: Additional properties of the sheet if this sheet is a grid. (If the sheet is an object sheet, containing a chart or image, then this field will be absent.) When writing it is an error to set any grid properties on non-grid sheets.

rowCount.description: Number of rows in the sheet. Must be at least 1.

columnCount.description: Number of columns in the sheet. Must be at least 1.

frozenRowCount.description: Number of frozen rows. Must be non-negative.

frozenColumnCount.description: Number of frozen columns. Must be non-negative.

hideGridlines.description: Whether to hide gridlines in the sheet.

rowGroupControlAfter.description: Whether row group controls are shown after the group.

columnGroupControlAfter.description: Whether column group controls are shown after the group.

hidden.description: True if the sheet is hidden in the UI, false if it's visible.

tabColor.description: (Deprecated) The color of the tab in the UI. Deprecated: Use tabColorStyle.

rgbColor.description: RGB color value. Document styles can only have RGB colors.

tabColorStyle.description: The color of the tab in the UI. If tabColor is also set, this field takes precedence.

rightToLeft.description: True if the sheet is an RTL sheet instead of an LTR sheet.

merges.description: List of merged cell ranges in the sheet.

items.description: A range on a sheet. All indexes are zero-based and half-open ([startIndex, endIndex)). Missing indexes indicate the range is unbounded on that side. Start index must be less than or equal to end index.

sheetId.description: ID of the sheet containing the range. Must be non-negative.

startRowIndex.description: Zero-based start row index (inclusive). Must be non-negative.

endRowIndex.description: Zero-based end row index (exclusive). Must be non-negative.

startColumnIndex.description: Zero-based start column index (inclusive). Must be non-negative.

endColumnIndex.description: Zero-based end column index (exclusive). Must be non-negative.

bandedRanges.description: List of banded (alternating color) ranges for better readability.

items.description: A banded (alternating colors) range to visually distinguish adjacent rows or columns for improved readability. Supports custom row/column colors for headers, footers, and alternating stripes.

sheetId.description: ID of the sheet containing the range. Must be non-negative.

startRowIndex.description: Zero-based start row index (inclusive). Must be non-negative.

endRowIndex.description: Zero-based end row index (exclusive). Must be non-negative.

startColumnIndex.description: Zero-based start column index (inclusive). Must be non-negative.

endColumnIndex.description: Zero-based end column index (exclusive). Must be non-negative.

developerMetadata.description: List of developer metadata objects associated with the sheet.

items.description:
Developer metadata associated with a location or object in a spreadsheet.

Developer metadata may be used to associate arbitrary data with various parts
of a spreadsheet and will remain associated at those locations as they move around
and the spreadsheet is edited.

metadataId.description: The spreadsheet-scoped unique ID that identifies the metadata. IDs may be specified when metadata is created, otherwise one will be randomly generated and assigned. Must be positive.

metadataKey.description: The metadata key. There may be multiple metadata in a spreadsheet with the same key. Developer metadata must always have a key specified.

metadataValue.description: Data associated with the metadata's key.

location.description: The location where the metadata is associated.

dimensionRange.description: Represents the row or column when metadata is associated with a dimension. The specified DimensionRange must represent a single row or column; it cannot be unbounded or span multiple rows or columns.

sheetId.description: ID of the sheet containing the dimension range. Must be non-negative.

dimension.description: The dimension of the range. Either ROWS or COLUMNS.

startIndex.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive). Must be non-negative.

endIndex.description: Zero-based end index (exclusive). Must be non-negative and >= startIndex.

data.description: Grid data organized by A1 range keys. Keys use A1 notation: optional sheet prefix with '!', using quoted sheet names when the tab name contains spaces or '!'. The range part may be a single cell (A1), rectangle (A1:B2), full columns (A:B), full rows (1:10), or other forms accepted by the simulation's A1 parser. Values are 2D arrays of cell values. Only one range key per sheet is allowed.

additionalProperties.description: Array of rows for a specific range.

items.description: A row of cell values.
Cell value. Can be string, integer, number, boolean, or null.

name: get_spreadsheet
description: Gets the latest version of a specified spreadsheet, including its metadata and a list of all available sheet names.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve.

ranges.description: The ranges to retrieve, in A1 notation. The A1 notation is a syntax used to define a cell or range of cells with a string that contains the sheet name plus the starting and ending cell coordinates using column letters and row numbers like: "Sheet1!A1:D3" or "A1:D3". Defaults to None.

items.description: A1 notation range string (e.g., "Sheet1!A1:D3" or "A1:D3").

includeGridData.description: Whether to include grid data. Defaults to False.

name: get_spreadsheet_by_data_filter
description: Gets spreadsheet data filtered by specified criteria.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve.

includeGridData.description: Whether to include grid data. If not provided or None is passed, False is used.

dataFilters.description: List of data filters. If not provided or None is passed, an empty list is used. Each filter must specify exactly ONE of: a1Range, gridRange, or developerMetadataLookup (mutually exclusive).

items.description: A single data filter. Must match exactly ONE of the mutually exclusive shapes below: an a1Range filter, a gridRange filter, or a developerMetadataLookup filter. The DataFilter model enforces the same exactly-one rule at runtime via model_post_init.

anyOf.description: Data filter using A1 notation only.

gridRange.description: A range on a sheet. All indexes are zero-based and half open ([startIndex, endIndex)). Missing indexes mean the range is unbounded.

sheetId.description: The sheet this range is on (non-negative).

startRowIndex.description: The start row (inclusive). Unbounded if not set.

endRowIndex.description: The end row (exclusive). Unbounded if not set.

startColumnIndex.description: The start column (inclusive). Unbounded if not set.

endColumnIndex.description: The end column (exclusive). Unbounded if not set.

developerMetadataLookup.description: Developer metadata lookup criteria. At least one of metadataKey, metadataValue, or metadataId must be provided.

metadataKey.description: Key of the metadata to look up.

metadataId.description: ID of the metadata to look up (non-negative).

name: get_spreadsheet_values
description: Gets values from a specific range in a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve values from.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to retrieve values from.
Supports various formats:
    Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
    - Single cell: "A1"
    - Cell range: "A1:B2"
    - Full column: "A:B"
    - Full row: "1:2"
    - Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

    With sheet names (recommended for multi-sheet spreadsheets):
    - Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
    - Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
    - Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
    - Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
    - Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"
    - Sheet-only: "Sheet1" (entire sheet)

    Note: If no sheet name specified, first sheet is automatically used.

majorDimension.description: The major dimension that results should use. If not specified, defaults to "ROWS". Valid values: "ROWS", "COLUMNS".

valueRenderOption.description: How values should be rendered in the output. If not specified, defaults to "FORMATTED_VALUE". Valid values: "FORMATTED_VALUE", "UNFORMATTED_VALUE", "FORMULA".

dateTimeRenderOption.description: How dates, times, and durations should be rendered. If not specified, defaults to "FORMATTED_STRING". Valid values: "SERIAL_NUMBER", "FORMATTED_STRING".

name: update_spreadsheet_values
description: Updates values in a specific range of a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to update. Supports various formats:

Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Full row: "1:2"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names (recommended for multi-sheet spreadsheets):
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

Note: If no sheet name specified, first sheet is automatically used.

valueInputOption.description:
How the input data should be interpreted.
Valid values: "RAW" (values inserted as-is) or
"USER_ENTERED" (values parsed as if entered by user).
In USER_ENTERED mode, date-like strings are interpreted
according to the spreadsheet's locale (for example, "en_US"
uses MM/DD/YYYY, while "en_GB"/"en_AU" use DD/MM/YYYY) and may
be converted to underlying date serial numbers.

values.description: A 2D array of rows to update. Each inner array is one row; each cell is a string, number, boolean, or null (empty).

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the updated values in the response.

responseValueRenderOption.description:
How values should be rendered in the response.

Valid values:
- "FORMATTED_VALUE": Returns formatted values. In this mode
  responseDateTimeRenderOption is ignored and date values are returned as
  formatted strings.
- "UNFORMATTED_VALUE": Returns the underlying stored values; when combined
  with responseDateTimeRenderOption="SERIAL_NUMBER", date values are
  returned as locale-aware serial numbers.
- "FORMULA": Preserves formulas in the response; non-formula cells are
  rendered according to responseDateTimeRenderOption.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description:
How dates, times, and durations should be rendered in the response. Defaults to "SERIAL_NUMBER".

Valid values:
- "SERIAL_NUMBER": Converts recognized date values to Excel-style serial numbers,
  using the spreadsheet's locale (for example, "en_US" as MM/DD/YYYY and
  "en_GB"/"en_AU" as DD/MM/YYYY). Date parsing for serial numbers respects the
  spreadsheet's locale in the same way as USER_ENTERED date input.
- "FORMATTED_STRING": Returns date values as plain strings with any internal
  DATE: markers stripped.

This option is applied only when responseValueRenderOption is "UNFORMATTED_VALUE"
or "FORMULA"; it is ignored when responseValueRenderOption is "FORMATTED_VALUE".
